_about: All adjustable settings for the birthday video. Edit values, save, then run render (see README_SETTINGS.md). Any key you delete falls back to its built-in default. Colours are hex. Times are seconds.

nightsky._help: The Night Sky film (film.py). Times in seconds. The name is drawn as a constellation, the camera flies through it, her photos gather into the mosaic, then the message plays while single photos lift out of it.

fonts._help: File names inside C:\Windows\Fonts. Sizes are pixels on the 1080x1920 canvas.

files._help: Relative paths are resolved against this project folder.

timeline._help: Mosaic clip length is read from the clip itself. reading_seconds_per_word controls how long each message paragraph stays on screen.

music._help: The song is played from 0:00 through the message, then jumps to finale_song_start so its loudest part lands under the final portrait.

grade._help: Global look applied to every scene. warmth = R,G,B gain. shadow_tint = colour added to dark areas (teal). bloom = glow around bright areas. chromatic_aberration = subtle colour fringe at the edges.

mosaic_grade._help: Extra grade for the mosaic section only. Lower red / raise blue in tint to cool it down; raise saturation for more vibrance.

motion._help: 0 disables an effect. Higher = more movement.

transitions._help: kind: dissolve | iris (circle opens from centre) | sweep (soft wipe upward). push_in zooms the new scene in from slightly larger; push_out zooms the old scene; flash adds a golden glow pulse.

output._help: encoder: x264 (CPU, fastest here) or amf (AMD GPU, slower on this machine). crf: lower = better quality, bigger file.
